@metadata.comment: English UI messages. Banana format: https://github.com/wikimedia/banana-i18n

shell-welcome: A quiet place to write your novel.
settings-save-failed: Your settings couldn't be saved. They'll apply until you close Plot Device.
dialog-new-project-location: Choose where to create the project
new-project-hint: Next, choose where to keep the project's folder.
open-failed-not-a-project: This folder isn't a Plot Device project. Choose a folder that has a project.md file.
open-failed-unreadable: This project couldn't be read. Nothing was changed.
open-failed-newer-format: This project was made with a newer version of Plot Device.
open-failed-not-recent: That project is no longer in the recent list.
create-failed-folder-exists: A folder with that name is already there.
create-failed-inside-project: Choose a place outside another project.
navigator-no-chapters: This book has no chapters yet.
change-failed-stale: The contents changed in another app. They have been reloaded; please try again.
change-failed-name-taken: Another file already has that name.
change-failed-invalid-name: That name can't be used for a file.
change-failed: That change couldn't be made. Nothing was changed.
chapter-unreadable: This chapter can't be shown: it isn't valid text, or its details are damaged. Nothing in it will be changed.
save-failed: Couldn't save. Your text is kept here, and saving will try again as you type.
conflict-title: This chapter changed in another app
conflict-body: While you were writing, “$1” was changed outside Plot Device. Your newest text hasn't been saved over it.
conflict-keep-both-detail: Your text is saved as a new file next to the chapter, and the chapter shows the other version.
conflict-use-mine-detail: Your text replaces the other version. The other changes will be lost.
conflict-kept: Your text was saved as “$1”, under Not in the book yet.
conflict-failed: That didn't work. Your text is still kept; please try again.
story-no-outlines: No outlines yet. Each outline is a plain Markdown file in the outlines folder.
story-manuscript-hint: The reading order, as the book has it. Chapters are arranged in Write.
outline-empty: This outline is empty. Start with a section.
confirm-delete-item: Delete “$1”? Everything inside it goes too.
confirm-delete-section: Delete the section “$1” and everything in it?
kept-explanation: The board can't show this, so it stays exactly as written. Edit it in a text editor.
locked-item: This item shares its line with other Markdown, so it can't be moved.
invalid-details: The details at the top of this file couldn't be read. The outline still works, and they are left as they are.
outline-changed-elsewhere: This outline changed in another app. It has been reloaded; please try again.
outline-undo-refused: This outline changed in another app since your last change, so undo would overwrite it.
outline-refused-unnamed-section: Cards above the first section can't be changed this way. Move them into a section first.
outline-refused-multiline-heading: This heading is written over two lines. Rename it in a text editor.
outline-failed: That change couldn't be made. Nothing was changed.
reference-hint: The first paragraph is the description; everything after it is details.
reference-invalid-details: The details at the top of this page couldn't be read. The page still works, and they are left as they are.
reference-failed: That page couldn't be changed. Nothing was changed.
shelf-search: Find a character, place or note
shelf-empty: Search, or pin a page to keep it here.
link-search: Find a chapter, character, place or note
versions-none: No earlier versions yet. They are kept as you write, at most every ten minutes.
versions-restore-detail: What you have now is kept as a version, so this can be undone.
versions-restored: The earlier version is back. What you had is kept as a version.
versions-stale: This file changed in another app since you opened its versions. Nothing was restored.
versions-failed: That didn't work. Nothing was changed.
